correctness.rationale: All automorphisms are permutations because invertible square vectors force singleton column supports over the binary field. Exact transposition centralizer group count gives p_n; dimensions of other commuting algebras and Bonferroni pair intersections yield an absolute O(n^4 2^-4n) error. Python exhaustive n=2,3,4 checks confirm finite boundaries; all n are covered by the mathematical argument.
